metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the Rust CLI in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) and [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). It builds as requested with an empty `[dependencies]` section and provides:

`ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
`ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

The binary includes `.ics` line unfolding, parameter parsing with RFC 6868 decoding, typed component extraction for VCALENDAR/VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL/VFREEBUSY/VTIMEZONE/VAVAILABILITY/AVAILABLE/VALARM, JSON emission for the required schemas, RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE/EXRULE handling, override handling with `RECURRENCE-ID` and `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`, and in-file `VTIMEZONE` resolution for zoned expansion.

Verified with `cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` and a sample recurring timezone-aware event via `cargo run --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml -- expand ...`, which produced the expected expanded UTC occurrences.
